other.name: Per-payoff fee beyond first mortgage, refinance

bundlingNotes: Buyer's $1,275 settlement fee is stated to include title exam, electronic storage/access, courier costs, and tax certificate. Seller's $550 fee includes notary fees, courier/wire costs, and e-document storage/delivery. Refinance's $975 fee includes 'Title Examination/Abstractor,' notary fees, and 'Settlement/Closing fee.' All three fees are explicitly flat/fixed regardless of transaction value, with title insurance premiums and transfer/recordation taxes billed separately. Notably the buyer fee ($1,275) is more than double the seller fee ($550) for the same company -- the largest buyer/seller settlement-fee asymmetry found in this survey to date, reflecting DC's heavier buyer-side title-exam and policy-issuance workload versus the seller's comparatively light payoff-coordination role.
transactionContext: Residential purchase (buyer), sale (seller), and refinance (borrower) settlement fees for Washington DC (refinance figure also covers parts of MD/VA suburbs); independent title/escrow company, richest itemized DC-area source found.

endpointOrParams: ASP.NET WebForms cascading-postback flow driven via plain HTTP GET/POST (no browser/JS execution): GET the form to capture __VIEWSTATE/__VIEWSTATEGENERATOR/__EVENTVALIDATION -> POST __EVENTTARGET=ddlState (State=DC) -> POST __EVENTTARGET=ddlCounties (County=11001/District Of Columbia, the tool's only DC county option) -> POST __EVENTTARGET=ddlCity (City=Washington) -> POST btnGetQuestions=Continue (reveals a per-state policy/recording-question panel) -> POST btnGetQuote=Get Quote, answering every revealed Yes/No question with the tool's own pre-checked default (never a fabricated answer). scenario: $500,000 purchase price / $400,000 loan amount, District of Columbia County (Washington), Purchase transaction type, Simultaneous (Owner+Lender) policy, Fee Type = All, Quick Quote detail level.
methodology: New nationwide calculator recipe, first applied here. Discovered via a from-scratch fetch of Westcor's previously connection-blocked 'all 50 states' rate-quote tool (ratequote.wltic.com/Quote?k=Westcor-All), which resolved cleanly this session. The tool renders a standard ASP.NET WebForms cascading-dropdown quote form (State -> County -> City) followed by a dynamically-rendered state-specific Yes/No question panel before the final quote; every question was left at its own pre-selected default per this project's standing convention. This is the first calculator successfully harvested for DC -- FNF's DC flow has completed without error but never produced a result across multiple prior sessions (see this file's 2026-08-18/2026-08-19 entries), so Westcor is DC's 3rd distinct calculator-basis provider, clearing the 3-provider threshold.
